about: The only extra Python packages a py-module@1 activity may install (micropip, our own pinned index; never open PyPI). Each entry: a pure-Python wheel, its sha256 and size, no dependencies of its own (list each dependency as its own entry). Add one by review only; tools/fetch_pyodide.py downloads and checks them into <site>/vendor/pywheels/.

quantiphy.why: physical quantities with SI prefixes and units (4.7 kΩ, 1.59 kHz) for electronics activities
